Scale: the plate is square and about 26 cm across in the image. It spans roughly 140 to 600 px, so about 460 px, or roughly 17.7 px per cm.

Cauliflower covers an area of roughly 200 px by 270 px, which is about 11 cm by 15 cm. It is heaped about 3 cm high with an irregular shape. That gives a volume of around 250 cm³. Cooked florets are loose and have air gaps, so I use a density of about 0.5 g/cm³. That is roughly 130 g. Weighing it against how it looks, I settle on about 140 g.

Meat is sliced beef, with about 5 pieces. The footprint is roughly 150 px by 230 px, or 8.5 cm by 13 cm. At about 1.5 cm thick, the pieces cover only part of that area. I estimate about 90 g.

There is also a small amount of herb or sauce, about 10 g.
